sources.market: Tushare daily_info: SH_MARKET (SH_A + SH_B before 2019) + SZ_MARKET
sources.turnover: Tushare daily_info: float_mv-weighted tr of SH_A, SH_B, SH_STAR (since 2019-07-22), SZ_MARKET

methodology.scope: Shanghai/Shenzhen stocks including A/B shares; excludes Beijing, funds and bonds
methodology.sampling: Last available observation per metric per ISO week, with its actual date; not a weekly sum
methodology.turnover: All years use disjoint board float_mv weights; replaces the previous exchange-level weights
methodology.missing: No zero fill or carry-forward; financing starts with the 2010 launch; limit list starts in 2020
